box_sync_key_retired_check.name: box_sync_key_retired_check
box_sync_key_retired_check.value: "core"."box_sync_key"."retired_at" is null or "core"."box_sync_key"."retired_reason" is not null

credential_revocation_check.name: credential_revocation_check
credential_revocation_check.value: ("core"."credential"."active" and "core"."credential"."revoked_at" is null) or (not "core"."credential"."active" and "core"."credential"."revoked_at" is not null)

device_address_unique.name: device_address_unique
device_address_unique.where: address is not null and archived_at is null

device_credential_target_check.name: device_credential_target_check
device_credential_target_check.value:
("core"."device_credential"."kind" = 'box' and "core"."device_credential"."box_id" is not null and "core"."device_credential"."station_id" is null)
          or ("core"."device_credential"."kind" <> 'box' and "core"."device_credential"."station_id" is not null and "core"."device_credential"."box_id" is null)

discount_definition_value_for_kind_check.name: discount_definition_value_for_kind_check
discount_definition_value_for_kind_check.value: ("pos"."discount_definition"."kind" = 'percent' and "pos"."discount_definition"."value_bp" is not null) or ("pos"."discount_definition"."kind" = 'fixed' and "pos"."discount_definition"."value_satang" is not null) or ("pos"."discount_definition"."kind" = 'free_item' and "pos"."discount_definition"."free_product_id" is not null)

discount_definition_validity_check.name: discount_definition_validity_check
discount_definition_validity_check.value: "pos"."discount_definition"."valid_from" is null or "pos"."discount_definition"."valid_until" is null or "pos"."discount_definition"."valid_until" >= "pos"."discount_definition"."valid_from"

discount_definition_usage_limit_check.name: discount_definition_usage_limit_check
discount_definition_usage_limit_check.value: ("pos"."discount_definition"."usage_limit" is null or "pos"."discount_definition"."usage_limit" > 0) and ("pos"."discount_definition"."per_customer_limit" is null or "pos"."discount_definition"."per_customer_limit" > 0)

modifier_group_library_name_unique.name: modifier_group_library_name_unique
modifier_group_library_name_unique.where: product_id is null and archived_at is null

modifier_group_bounds_check.name: modifier_group_bounds_check
modifier_group_bounds_check.value: ("pos"."modifier_group"."min_select" is null or "pos"."modifier_group"."min_select" >= 0) and ("pos"."modifier_group"."max_select" is null or "pos"."modifier_group"."max_select" >= 1) and ("pos"."modifier_group"."min_select" is null or "pos"."modifier_group"."max_select" is null or "pos"."modifier_group"."max_select" >= "pos"."modifier_group"."min_select")

modifier_group_single_no_bounds_check.name: modifier_group_single_no_bounds_check
modifier_group_single_no_bounds_check.value: "pos"."modifier_group"."selection_type" = 'multi' or ("pos"."modifier_group"."min_select" is null and "pos"."modifier_group"."max_select" is null)

payment_attempt_terminal_ref_unique.name: payment_attempt_terminal_ref_unique
payment_attempt_terminal_ref_unique.where: device_id is not null and terminal_ref is not null

payment_attempt_amount_check.name: payment_attempt_amount_check
payment_attempt_amount_check.value:
"pos"."payment_attempt"."amount_satang" >= 0
          and ("pos"."payment_attempt"."tendered_satang" is null or "pos"."payment_attempt"."tendered_satang" >= 0)
          and ("pos"."payment_attempt"."change_satang" is null or "pos"."payment_attempt"."change_satang" >= 0)

payment_notification_payment_unique.name: payment_notification_payment_unique
payment_notification_payment_unique.where: tran_ref is null and payment_id is not null

payment_notification_key_check.name: payment_notification_key_check
payment_notification_key_check.value: "pos"."payment_notification"."tran_ref" is not null or "pos"."payment_notification"."payment_id" is not null

product_code_unique.name: product_code_unique
product_code_unique.where: code is not null and archived_at is null

product_sku_unique.name: product_sku_unique
product_sku_unique.where: sku is not null and archived_at is null

product_category_code_unique.name: product_category_code_unique
product_category_code_unique.where: code is not null and archived_at is null

product_category_top_level_taxable_check.name: product_category_top_level_taxable_check
product_category_top_level_taxable_check.value: "pos"."product_category"."parent_id" is not null or "pos"."product_category"."taxable_category" is not null

sale_non_negative_check.name: sale_non_negative_check
sale_non_negative_check.value: "pos"."sale"."subtotal_satang" >= 0 and "pos"."sale"."discount_satang" >= 0 and "pos"."sale"."manual_discount_satang" >= 0 and "pos"."sale"."promo_discount_satang" >= 0 and "pos"."sale"."net_satang" >= 0 and "pos"."sale"."service_charge_satang" >= 0 and "pos"."sale"."tax_inclusive_satang" >= 0 and "pos"."sale"."tax_exclusive_satang" >= 0 and "pos"."sale"."gross_satang" >= 0 and "pos"."sale"."unapplied_discount_satang" >= 0 and "pos"."sale"."refunded_satang" >= 0

sale_receipt_parts_check.name: sale_receipt_parts_check
sale_receipt_parts_check.value:
("pos"."sale"."receipt_number" is null and "pos"."sale"."receipt_series" is null and "pos"."sale"."receipt_seq" is null)
          or ("pos"."sale"."receipt_number" is not null and "pos"."sale"."receipt_series" is not null and "pos"."sale"."receipt_seq" is not null and "pos"."sale"."receipt_seq" > 0)

sale_finalised_check.name: sale_finalised_check
sale_finalised_check.value: "pos"."sale"."status" not in ('finalised','refunded') or ("pos"."sale"."receipt_number" is not null and "pos"."sale"."finalised_at" is not null)

sale_void_check.name: sale_void_check
sale_void_check.value: "pos"."sale"."status" <> 'voided' or ("pos"."sale"."voided_at" is not null and "pos"."sale"."void_reason" is not null)

sale_discount_manual_check.name: sale_discount_manual_check
sale_discount_manual_check.value: "pos"."sale_discount"."kind" <> 'manual' or ("pos"."sale_discount"."reason" is not null and "pos"."sale_discount"."applied_by_account_id" is not null)

sale_discount_value_check.name: sale_discount_value_check
sale_discount_value_check.value:
("pos"."sale_discount"."discount_type" <> 'percent' or "pos"."sale_discount"."percent_bp" is not null)
          and ("pos"."sale_discount"."discount_type" <> 'fixed' or "pos"."sale_discount"."value_satang" is not null)

sale_line_non_negative_check.name: sale_line_non_negative_check
sale_line_non_negative_check.value: "pos"."sale_line"."base_satang" >= 0 and "pos"."sale_line"."discount_satang" >= 0 and "pos"."sale_line"."net_satang" >= 0 and "pos"."sale_line"."service_charge_satang" >= 0 and "pos"."sale_line"."tax_satang" >= 0 and "pos"."sale_line"."gross_satang" >= 0 and "pos"."sale_line"."tax_rate_bp" >= 0

staff_token_revocation_check.name: staff_token_revocation_check
staff_token_revocation_check.value:
"core"."staff_token"."revoked_at" is not null
          or ("core"."staff_token"."revoked_reason" is null and "core"."staff_token"."revoked_by_account_id" is null)

station_code_prefix_unique.name: station_code_prefix_unique
station_code_prefix_unique.where: code_prefix is not null and archived_at is null

station_session_lease_complete_check.name: station_session_lease_complete_check
station_session_lease_complete_check.value:
("edge"."station_session"."lease_id" is null and "edge"."station_session"."lease_holder" is null and "edge"."station_session"."lease_expires_at" is null)
          or ("edge"."station_session"."lease_id" is not null and "edge"."station_session"."lease_holder" is not null and "edge"."station_session"."lease_expires_at" is not null)

voucher_expiring_idx.name: voucher_expiring_idx
voucher_expiring_idx.where: expires_at is not null and status = 'issued'

voucher_hold_check.name: voucher_hold_check
voucher_hold_check.value:
("promo"."voucher"."held_sale_id" is null and "promo"."voucher"."held_station_id" is null and "promo"."voucher"."held_at" is null and "promo"."voucher"."held_by_account_id" is null)
          or ("promo"."voucher"."held_sale_id" is not null and "promo"."voucher"."held_station_id" is not null and "promo"."voucher"."held_at" is not null and "promo"."voucher"."status" = 'issued')

voucher_redemption_reason_check.name: voucher_redemption_reason_check
voucher_redemption_reason_check.value:
("promo"."voucher_redemption"."kind" = 'released') = ("promo"."voucher_redemption"."reason" is not null)
          and ("promo"."voucher_redemption"."reason" is null or "promo"."voucher_redemption"."reason" in ('line_removed','sale_voided','moved','lapsed','sale_closed'))
